headSubject: feat(STOR-25): Java migration hooks on the isolated plugin pool -- B1 (REAL_LIFT_PLAN_2026-09-03, B13)
summary: Implemented and verified B2/SEC-9 (REAL_LIFT_PLAN_2026-09-03 Track B, boundary B30): plugin:java-controller now crosses the process boundary the same way B1 (STOR-25) isolated Java migration hooks -- a host-side proxy (PluginControllerProxyHandler) dispatches every request through the existing PluginIpcChildProcessPool via a new generator-derived AST route table, an in-child reflective dispatcher (ManifestDrivenJavaControllerPluginHandler) binds @PathVariable/@RequestParam/@RequestBody and invokes the real controller method; found and fixed a real bug live (D9's minimumRole interceptor was invisible to the new SimpleUrlHandlerMapping until attached directly) and a RuntimeHost coverage-ratchet regression (fixed by extracting testable logic into runtimehost-core).
nextStep: The last run-all-gates.ps1 invocation (log: D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\Build\digest-logs\20260905T043507Z-pwsh--NoProfile--File.log) showed generator/runtimeHost/kernel gates all PASSED, and the AI-knowledge gate's two previously-failing checks (coverage ratchet, security-pattern-sweep) were independently re-verified clean, but the log stopped advancing at step 38/39 for several minutes and the gate's own final PASS/FAIL summary line was never observed before this session closed. First check whether that log finished (tail it, or look for a newer digest-logs entry); if it truly stalled, re-run 'python scripts/ai/run_digest.py -- pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/quality/run-all-gates.ps1' fresh. Once you have a clean all-four-green confirmation, add the exact gate timings to ledger/items/SEC-9.yml's guard section (currently says provenRed: true with the r10 proof as the guard ref -- that part is already accurate) and commit all of this session's changes (everything is currently uncommitted -- see git status: ~16 modified + ~13 new files across NPDevGenerator, NPDevRuntimeHost, NPDevRuntimeHost/runtimehost-core, NPDevSamples/probes/p7-plugin-controller, ledger/, docs/, scripts/policy, scripts/quality, scripts/proofs).
verified: run-generator-gate.ps1 PASSED (117.5s). run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 PASSED (517.1s) -- confirms the coverage-ratchet fix: NPDevRuntimeHost measured 18.3622% against recorded floor 18.3481% (previously regressed to 18.2833%). run-kernel-quality-gate.ps1 PASSED (17.1s) -- this gate's earlier failure was collateral from the same RuntimeHost coverage regression (run-kernel-quality-gate.ps1 invokes the repo-wide check-coverage-ratchet.py with no module filter), not a real kernel/adapters issue. run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1: its two previously-failing checks re-verified clean standalone after fixes -- coverage ratchet (step 36/39: NPDevRuntimeHost 18.3622%, 'Coverage ratchet OK') and security-pattern-sweep (step 6/39: 643 hits, 0 needing triage, after triaging fingerprint b2b8c814f99c into scripts/quality/security-pattern-sweep-allowlist.json and raising frozenCount 538->539) -- but the gate's own combined final PASS/FAIL line was not observed before session close. Also verified live via scripts/proofs/run-r10-plugin-controller-proof.py against a real generated app (NPDevSamples/probes/p7-plugin-controller): all three assertions passing across two separate runs (admin-gated mount returns the exact pre-existing response body {"ok":true,"controller":"AdminToolsController"} through the isolated child process; superuser-gated mount still returns 403 -- re-verified after the interceptor-wiring fix; a new @PathVariable/@RequestParam echo route binds correctly end to end through the generator's own emitted plugin-controller-routes.json manifest). Manually confirmed via Win32_Process that booting the assembled app spawns two real child java.exe processes running PluginIpcChildProcessMain as children of the app's own JVM -- not an in-process simulation.
